# HybridGenerativeMaintainability

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design principle for generative systems that balances modularity, reusability, and adaptability of components across symbolic and subsymbolic processing layers. Provides a framework for integrating TCC-style topology-aware modules with iNEST neuromorphic substrates while preserving system evolvability.
